normalized.result:
F1 feels more natural because I can browse all my tags without first finding an item that already has the right one, and combining a tag filter with text search is useful.

For search, I’d also expect it to match the URL and ignore capitalization. I’d like `#tag` searches, quoted exact phrases, and more precise combinations using AND, OR, NOT, and parentheses when I need them. Searching tags as ordinary text is useful, but it doesn’t fully replace those options.
